author: hyunback
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp

key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.

CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_intel_cpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.
root_cause: The CMake function ov_generate_plugins_hpp (in cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186) calls ov_target_link_plugins (in plugins.cmake:275/327), which attempts to link MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets into the test target. CMake does not allow MODULE_LIBRARY (shared modules loaded at runtime via dlopen) to be linked into other targets. This is a code regression in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake introduced around 2026-08-08, affecting the Android build specifically, and is unrelated to the GPU plugin PR in this merge queue entry. The issue has been recurring since 2026-08-08.
reproduction_steps: Configure OpenVINO for Android cross-compilation; CMake fails during configure with MODULE_LIBRARY link errors.
recommended_actions: Identify which commit around 2026-08-08 modified cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake or cmake/extra_modules.cmake to introduce the MODULE_LIBRARY link attempt
Revert or fix the ov_target_link_plugins call so it does not attempt to directly link MODULE_LIBRARY targets
Consider changing plugin targets to SHARED libraries or using OBJECT/INTERFACE approaches for the generate_plugins_hpp step
prevention_strategies: Any CMake changes to plugin registration (plugins.cmake, extra_modules.cmake) should be tested with Android cross-compilation configuration before merging. Add a CI precheck that validates CMake configure completes for Android.
historical_context: This pattern was first seen on 2026-08-08 and has recurred 8 times. It is a systemic Android build breakage unrelated to individual PRs entering the merge queue.
